historic_survey.note: A downtown tower by Johnson & Burgee capped with a mirror-glass faux mansard and a ring of draped figures - the 'corporate goddesses' commissioned from artist Muriel Castanis - and one of the most extreme of the articulated tops that followed the 1985 Downtown Plan.

unknowns: The statement dates this tower 1986 on p. 43 and 1984 on pp. 128-129.
